clean: I never thought I would be the kind of person who gets up at 5 in the morning to run. In fact, for most of my life I avoided exercise like it was homework, but last winter my doctor told me my blood pressure was too high, and something in me just decided enough. So I bought a cheap pair of running shoes and went out the next morning in the dark. I made it exactly two blocks before I had to stop and hold onto a lamp post, but I went back the next day, and the next. Now, 10 months later, I can run 5 kilometers without stopping, and more importantly I actually look forward to it, the quiet streets, the sunrise, the feeling that the day belongs to me.
